text:
Samira: FYI found an S3 object in partner-bucket that looks like a Vault-transit ciphertext - key name `workspace_vault_transit_blob.bin`. Not public, but partner-ci-role has read access. blob starts with `vault:v1:` prefix.
sec-bot: Alert: object-read by external-arn detected on partner-bucket (rule: s3-external-access). Created incident 3461239876.
Jason: can you paste the exact s3 path and first ~80 chars of the blob (no secrets, just headers/metadata)?
Samira: s3://partner-bucket/ci/artifacts/workspace_vault_transit_blob.bin
Samira: header (sanitized): `vault:v1:01ab3c...f4d` - looks like transit-wrapped ciphertext, not raw kms ciphertext.
Irfan: transit ciphertext -> anyone with UNWRAP capability on our Vault transit key could decrypt. If partner role could call our transit unwrap endpoint via a proxy, this is bad.
Maria: do we still have that cross-account binding from onboarding?
Samira: yes - partner-ci-role granted to `serviceAccount:partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` via a binding in project infra-onboard (expires 2025-06). Used by their CI to push artifacts.
Jason: immediate actions: 1) restrict partner-ci-role to deny transit unwrap 2) revoke active tokens for that role 3) enable Vault audit for transit ops 4) rotate transit key + rewrap affected blobs.
Oncall: executing containment - revoking role binding now.
Oncall: running:
  gcloud iam roles revoke-binding --project=infra-onboard --member="serviceAccount:partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/vault.proxy"
Oncall: disabling partner SA keys (if any):
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Irfan: next: rotate the transit key in Vault (forced rotate) and rewrap ciphertexts. Example:
  vault write -f transit/keys/app-transit-key/rotate
  vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="<old-cipher>" key="app-transit-key"
Samira: scanning partner-bucket for other `vault:v1:` objects.
Samira: found 7 blobs under ci/artifacts, 2 with `vault:v1:` prefix.
Maria: enable Vault audit device for transit endpoints and push logs to central logging for 90 days.
Maria:
  vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit_audit.log
Jason: rotation plan summary: forced rotate transit key -> rewrap all `vault:v1:` artifacts -> revoke any decrypted artifacts if evidence of unwrap -> invalidate short-lived tokens used by partner CI -> post-mortem + SOC/legal notif.
Irfan: to check unwrap events:
  cat /var/log/vault_transit_audit.log | jq -c 'select(.path | contains("transit/unwrap"))'
Samira: partner says they never called unwrap. We'll treat it as potentially compromised.
Oncall: containment complete - binding revoked and partner SA keys disabled. Handing off to EngSec for rotation.
Maria: tasks assigned:
  - Samira: list affected artifacts and store /sec/artifacts/3461239876.txt
  - Irfan: run forced rotate + rewrap (coord with runtime)
  - Jason: audit log analysis + timeline
  - Oncall: collect proof of revocation
Samira: uploaded artifact list to /sec/artifacts/3461239876.txt
Irfan: doing canary rotate in staging, then prod. ETA ~45m.
Jason: audit slice shows no successful transit/unwrap by partner-SA in last 90d. There are failed unwrap attempts (403) on 2026-03-18T09:12Z and 2026-03-19T01:04Z.
Maria: still rotate + rewrap. Also tighten Vault RBAC to avoid broad `vault:transit/*` grants - make decrypt restricted to internal identities.
Irfan: sample Vault policy HCL:
  path "transit/encrypt/*" {
    capabilities = ["update"]
  }
  path "transit/decrypt/*" {
    capabilities = ["update"]
    # restrict to internal-service identities
  }
Samira: contacting partner SOC and legal with initial facts and actions taken. Partner requested scrubbed object list; shared object keys only.
Maria: creating follow-up incident for post-rotation verification and rewrap audit. Scheduling 1-hour review tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
Oncall: adding runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vault-transit-rotation and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sec-incident-comms
Jason: thanks team :thumbsup: keep updates here.
Irfan: rewrap completed for the 2 blobs in partner-bucket, rotation propagated, audits show no unwraps. Marking as containment->mitigation in tracker.
Samira: running an overnight scan across partner buckets and will post results.
Maria: nice work team :lock:
